headline: Shenzhou 24 launches carrying Zeeshan Ali, Pakistan's first astronaut
label: BREAKING
caption:
History made 🚀🇵🇰 China's Shenzhou 24 has lifted off with Pakistan's Zeeshan Ali on board.

The spacecraft launched on a Long March 2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center early on Wednesday morning, Pakistan time, according to Dawn and Anadolu.

Zeeshan Ali, a 40 year old Pakistani fighter pilot, is now set to become the first Pakistani astronaut in orbit and the first foreign national ever to visit China's Tiangong space station. He flies as payload specialist alongside commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi.

He will spend about a week aboard the station carrying out scientific experiments for Pakistan before returning to Earth aboard the Shenzhou 23 spacecraft.
